title: Stan Marcus tells Nick Cook the bell slowed time

tellings.quote: And Nick Cook's source, Stan Marcus, told him that the Germans had been able to slow time within the area of the bell's torsion field.

plain: In Nazi Germany in the 1940s, a device known as the bell is said to have created a twisting energy field, called a torsion field, inside which time slowed down. Michels tells this as something a man named Nick Cook was told by his source, Stan Marcus, who said 'the Germans had been able to slow time within the area of the bell's torsion field.' If true, the Nazis would have built a machine that bent time.
